plans.idea: Classic skyscraper read top to bottom: brand lockup caps the column, a large headline and subhead block sits beneath it, and the bottle anchors the lower half so the canvas is filled evenly instead of leaving dead space at the bottom.
Product first: the bottle opens the column as the visual hook, the headline and subhead follow directly below it as the message, and the logo closes the stack at the bottom as the brand sign-off.

Message first with a brand sign-off: the headline and subhead lead at the very top at maximum size, the bottle sits centred in the middle band, and a full-width logo grounds the bottom, so headline, product and brand form three evenly spaced tiers.
